archetypes.name: dyn-pr-title-grammar
archetypes.rationale: Changed design-log PR title/body surfaces and the audit matcher grammar together.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the design-log PR title and body changes alongside the audit-runs title matching logic. Verify the new issue suffix is additive, preserves UUID-only extraction, and does not introduce inline PR bodies or weaken strict matching. Pay special attention to the stubbed gh capture in the regression test because the real body file is deleted after publish. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
